text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r f-o-r-g-e-d a l-o-n-g-d-i-s-t-a-n-c-e r-o-m-a-n-c-e p-e-r-s-o-n-a a-n-d p-u-b-l-i-s-h-e-d a m-e-s-s-a-g-e s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e t-h-a-t i-m-i-t-a-t-e-d e-m-o-t-i-o-n-a-l b-o-n-d-i-n-g, l-e-a-v-i-n-g b-e-h-i-n-d d-r-a-f-t p-r-o-f-i-l-e c-a-r-d s a-n-d c-h-a-t t-r-a-n-s-c-r-i-p-t s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d s-c-o-p-e a-p-p-r-o-v-a-l.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r t-r-i-g-g-e-r-e-d e-m-e-r-g-e-n-c-y p-a-y-m-e-n-t r-e-q-u-e-s-t s t-o h-i-g-h l-e-v-e l t-r-u-s t a-c-c-o-u-n-t s, d-e-p-o-s-i-t-i-n-g p-a-r-t-i-a l w-i-t-h-d-r-a-w-a-l c-o-n-f-i-r-m-a-t-i-o-n s i-n t-h-e m-o-n-i-t-o-r i-n-g l-o-g, b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g t-h-e d-u-a l a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-a-t-i-o-n c-o-n-t-r-o-l c-h-e-c-k.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-e-c-r-u-i-t-e-d m-o-n-e-y m-u-l-e s b-y o-f-f-e-r-i-n-g s-m-a-l l i-n-i-t-i-a l p-a-y-m-e-n-t s f-o-r t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r t-a-s-k s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g b-e-h-i-n-d a n a-m-b-y-s m-u-l-e r-o-l-l-c-a-l-l l-i-s-t a-n-d p-r-o-m-i-s-e-d f-e-e s-t-r-u-c-t-u-r-e, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r i-n-s-t-a-l-l-e-d i-s-o-l-a-t-i-o-n p-r-o-t-o-c-o-l s t-o p-r-e-v-e-n t v-i-c-t-i-m s f-r-o-m c-o-m-p-a-r-i-n-g n-o-t-e s, g-e-n-e-r-a-t-i-n-g p-e-r-s-o-n-a l i-z-e-d c-o-n-f-i-d-e-n-t-i-a-l i-t-y m-a-r-k-e-r s i-n d-i-a-l-o-g-u-e, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e t-h-i-r-d-p-a-r-t-y v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n l-o-o-p.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-e-l-a-y-e-d a-n-y f-o-r-m-a l r-e-p-o-r-t i-n-g t-h-r-o-u-g-h a-m-b-i-g-u-o-u s u-r-g-e-n-c-y l-a-n-g-u-a-g-e, p-l-a-c-i-n-g w-o-r-d-i-n-g t-h-a-t n-o r-e-p-o-r-t i-n g w-a-s n-e-c-e-s-s-a-r-y i-n t-h-e c-l-o-s-u-r-e s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r y h-o-t l-i-n-e d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e.
